findings.description: Flynn Properties took ownership of the 585,000-square-foot office building at 225 Bush Street via a deed in lieu of foreclosure, after buying the $221 million loan against it. The rest of the article, which also covers a second building (Market Center) acquired the same way, is paywalled past this lede.

citation.label: The Registry, “Flynn Properties Takes 585,000 SQFT 225 Bush via Deed in Lieu After $221MM Loan Buy in San Francisco,” 25 September 2026
citation.locator: opening sentence; the rest is behind a subscription wall

raw.text: Flynn Properties has now bought both 225 Bush St. and Market Center by acquiring the loan and taking [it via deed in lieu]

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 225 BUSH ST → parcel 0289007; sf-parcels has blklot 0289007 active, 225–225 BUSH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1948.

publish.note: Entry added to the existing page at /san-francisco/financial-district/bush-street/225/.

findings.description: Waymo has signed a letter of intent for about 120,000 square feet of Google's former space at One Market Plaza. Extracted from the headline and the visible lede, which name only the complex; the rest is paywalled. This page already carries a 2026-09-03 Chronicle exclusive reporting Disney landing in the same vacated Google footprint; the two are not the same event — that story is Disney signing, this one is a separate prospective tenant's letter of intent for a further chunk of the space three weeks later — so both stand.
